description: This file defines a migration class for version 5.6.1 of the OrangeHRM system, responsible for updating display field class names in the database during the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration that handles specific database updates for version 5.6.1 in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration by calling updateDisplayFieldClassNames to update specific display field class names.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.6.1' indicating the migration version.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassNames
methods.description: Retrieves display field IDs by alias and updates their class names to specific class implementations.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldIdFromFieldAlias
methods.description: Fetches the display field ID from the database for a given alias name.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassById
methods.description: Updates the class name of a display field in the database based on its ID.
